scope: Real R10/R11 audio control presentation and R18 regression verification

checks.name: Computed styles against handoff
checks.observation: Before check failed for inherited select weight/background, button padding and SVG size. After check passes on desktop and mobile.

checks.name: Controlled frozen-reference diff
checks.observation: Full-frame R10 MAE 3.528 to 3.183, R11 5.313 to 4.501. Device panel MAE 4.543 to 2.739 and 6.915 to 5.055. Reference hashes unchanged.

checks.name: Audio browser interactions
checks.observation: Enumerated microphone, activation switch, processing options and close-to-workspace pass on both viewports. No page errors.

checks.name: R18 browser regression
checks.observation: Six focus, keyboard, ACL presentation, DM-ID and preserved voice-store checks pass on desktop/mobile. Card MAE remains 0.876. No page errors.

checks.name: Native Web tests and build
checks.observation: Focused audio 3 files/14 tests and full Web 297 files/940 tests pass. TypeScript/Vite build and git diff --check pass.

checks.name: Strict full-design and physical media acceptance
checks.observation: Remaining pixel differences and measured versus decorative media state prevent a full 1:1 claim. Fixture verification does not prove physical audio or a live LiveKit session.
